summary: get_host_topology's agent_id and its REST twin's path-captured agent_id both lacked the length/control-character floor the two sibling tools (b3-7) got. AuditStore's sanitizer scrubs invalid UTF-8/NUL but not other C0 control bytes, so an unfloored agent_id let any Response:Read holder write raw control bytes/CR-LF into the audit trail's target_id. Not introduced by dc380fbbf but discovered within the exact function family it hardened for two siblings. Fixed both call sites with the identical floor.
